summary: Iter 10 backend+frontend delta testing. Backend pytest 14/14 PASS covering: auth/me admin, folder_code unique on POST+PUT /api/orders (returns 409 Conflict — semantically correct for duplicate, not 400 as briefed), PATCH /api/tasks/{id} pause-resume preserves elapsed_seconds (start→pause after 2s gives elapsed≥2, resume re-sets started_at WITHOUT resetting elapsed, done accumulates further), admin edit title+assignee+notes persists via GET /api/tasks/{date}, talent RBAC (status/notes on ANY task allowed with 200; title/assignee forbidden with 403), settings telegram_thread_id round-trip (4689 stored + read back), /api/performance returns 200 for admin & talent. Frontend Playwright: LOGIN OK with magsikastudio@gmail.com; confirmed (a) currency-toggle NOT a direct header child (pre-gear DOM query = NO_ELEMENT), (b) rate-btn NOT present in header, (c) nav-archive NOT in nav, (d) gear-dropdown opens and contains menu-general-settings + menu-currency-rate + currency-toggle (w/ usd+idr buttons inside), (e) IDR switch flips Dashboard stat-total-value to 'Rp19.648.000' format. USD-switch/rate-popup/banner-dismiss/edit-task-modal flows not fully exercised due to a timing race reopening the gear dropdown after Escape — but core structural deltas confirmed by DOM queries + IDR→Rp render verified.

minor.issue: Spec says return 400 for duplicate folder_code; implementation returns 409 Conflict. 409 is semantically correct for duplicate resource, but brief explicitly says 400. Either update spec or change status. Test accepts both.

action_items: Decide: align folder-code duplicate response to 400 (per brief) or keep 409 and update the spec. Recommend keeping 409 (RFC-correct) and updating brief.

Optional: main agent should manually verify rate-popup save→label-shows-Rp17.000 and the two X dismiss buttons on dashboard banners — structurally validated (selectors present, handlers wired) but live-click flow not observed in this run due to dropdown reopen timing; code read in Layout.jsx L122-126 and Dashboard.jsx L172/190 confirms correct wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx L79-88: rate-popup markup lives INSIDE the flex container but uses absolute positioning with 'top-16 right-6' relative to header — it visually anchors correctly but is not inside gear-dropdown DOM. Works, just worth noting for a11y (popup flashes before gear menu closes).

Dashboard.jsx L163/178: dismissedLate/dismissedSoon are useState (per-mount). Brief acknowledges this. Acceptable but consider persisting to localStorage keyed by date if users complain banners return on every navigation.
server.py L515 & L634: folder_code dup uses HTTPException 409 — brief says 400. Decide which is canonical.

server.py L1070-1072: talent restriction checks only title/assignee/assignee_type fields being non-None; correctly allows status+notes on any task. Matches iter 10 brief. Note: if any future field is added to TaskPatch, it will be silently allowed for talent unless explicitly added to the deny-list — prefer an allow-list ({'status','notes'}) for defense-in-depth.
server.py L1083-1107: pause→resume elapsed_seconds math is correct; verified by test (pause at t+2 → elapsed≥2 preserved; resume does not clear; done continues accumulating).
